WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
),
male_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loans_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996'
),
loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN l1996.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1996.total_amount != 0 THEN
            ((l1997.total_amount - l1996.total_amount) * 100.0 / l1996.total_amount)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS growth_rate
FROM loans_1996 l1996
CROSS JOIN loans_1997 l1997

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

),

    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100
    END as PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
ORDER BY c2012.Segment

    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, 1, INSTR(r1.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r1.time, ':', INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r1.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, INSTR(r1.time, ':', INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1) + 1, LENGTH(r1.time) - INSTR(r1.time, ':', INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1)) AS REAL)) AS REAL) AS champion_time_seconds,
    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) + 1, LENGTH(r2.time) - INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1)) AS REAL)) AS REAL) AS last_driver_time_seconds,
    ((last_driver_time_seconds - champion_time_seconds) / champion_time_seconds) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM results r1
JOIN results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId
JOIN races ON r1.raceId = races.raceId

WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM customer_min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_annual_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference

SELECT 
    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS REAL) AS champion_seconds,
    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS REAL) AS last_driver_seconds,
    ((CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) -
     (CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL))) /
    (CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    results champion
JOIN 
    results last_driver ON champion.raceId = last_driver.raceId
JOIN 
    races r ON champion.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year = 1988 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND champion.position = 1
    AND last_driver.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = champion.raceId AND statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'))
    AND champion.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
    AND last_driver.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg - lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg - kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg - sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

SELECT 
    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS REAL) /
    (CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    results champion
JOIN 
    results last_driver ON champion.raceId = last_driver.raceId
JOIN 
    races r ON champion.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year = 1988 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND champion.position = 1
    AND last_driver.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = champion.raceId AND statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'))
    AND champion.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
    AND last_driver.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')

        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption

    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (lam_avg - kam_avg) AS lam_kam_diff,

FROM segment_averages

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms

    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts
WHERE molecule_id IN (

    FROM molecule m

SELECT 
    CAST((CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, 1, INSTR(r1.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r1.time, ':', INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r1.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
          CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, INSTR(r1.time, ':', INSTR(r1.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS REAL) * 100.0 / 
    (CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS percentage_faster
FROM results r1
JOIN results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId
JOIN races ON r1.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 1988 
AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
AND r1.position = 1
AND r2.position = (
    SELECT MAX(position) 
    FROM results r3 
    JOIN races r4 ON r3.raceId = r4.raceId
    WHERE r4.year = 1988 
    AND r4.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r3.statusId IN (
        SELECT statusId 
        FROM status 
        WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'
    )
)
AND r1.statusId IN (
    SELECT statusId 
    FROM status 
    WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'
)
AND r2.statusId IN (
    SELECT statusId 
    FROM status 
    WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'
)

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

    (CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':', INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':', INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) * 100.0 / 
    (CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, 1, INSTR(last_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(last_time, ':', INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(last_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':', INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    (SELECT r.time as champion_time
     FROM results r
     JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
     WHERE ra.year = 1988 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
     AND r.position = 1
     AND r.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
    ) AS c,
    (SELECT r.time as last_time
     FROM results r
     JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId

WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
),
male_client_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loans_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996'
),
loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN l1996.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1996.total_amount != 0 THEN
            ((l1997.total_amount - l1996.total_amount) * 100.0 / l1996.total_amount)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS growth_rate
FROM loans_1996 l1996
CROSS JOIN loans_1997 l1997

WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM customer_min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_annual_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption END) - 
               MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption END)) / 
              MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption END)) * 100
    END AS percentage_increase

SELECT 
    ((CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver.time, INSTR(last_driver.time, ':', INSTR(last_driver.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) -
     (CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL))) /
    (CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(champion.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(champion.time, INSTR(champion.time, ':', INSTR(champion.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM 
    results champion
JOIN 
    results last_driver ON champion.raceId = last_driver.raceId
JOIN 
    races r ON champion.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    r.year = 1988 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND champion.position = 1
    AND last_driver.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = champion.raceId AND statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'))
    AND champion.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
    AND last_driver.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')

),
loans_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996'
),
loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
)

    CASE 
        WHEN l1996.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1996.total_amount != 0 THEN
            ((l1997.total_amount - l1996.total_amount) * 100.0 / l1996.total_amount)

FROM loans_1996 l1996

WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM customer_min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_annual_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (

        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption AS Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100
    END AS PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment

male_client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loans_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996'
),
loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_client_accounts mca ON l.account_id = mca.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN l1996.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1996.total_amount != 0 THEN
            ((l1997.total_amount - l1996.total_amount) * 100.0 / l1996.total_amount)

FROM loans_1996 l1996
CROSS JOIN loans_1997 l1997

WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM customer_min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_annual_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption AS Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100
    END AS PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
ORDER BY c2012.Segment

WITH AustralianGrandPrix1988 AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
ChampionTime AS (
    SELECT r.time AS champion_time
    FROM results r
    JOIN AustralianGrandPrix1988 agr ON r.raceId = agr.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1
),
LastFinisherTime AS (
    SELECT r.time AS last_finisher_time
    FROM results r
    JOIN AustralianGrandPrix1988 agr ON r.raceId = agr.raceId
    WHERE r.position IS NOT NULL
      AND r.statusId IN (
          SELECT statusId 
          FROM status 
          WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%'
      )
    ORDER BY r.position DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(
        (julianday(l.last_finisher_time) - julianday(c.champion_time)) * 100 AS REAL
    ) / CAST(
        julianday(c.champion_time) AS REAL
    ) AS percentage_faster
FROM ChampionTime c, LastFinisherTime l

WITH customer_payment AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customer_payment cp ON ym.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM customer_consumption
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) as balance_1993_03_22,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) as balance_1998_12_27
    FROM trans t

WITH latest_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_name ORDER BY pa.date DESC) as rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)
SELECT 
  ((MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) * 100.0 / 
   MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) AS percentage_difference
FROM latest_ratings
WHERE rn = 1
